items.markingKey: Milk left = V(1 − x/V)ⁿ = 50(1 − 10/50)^2 = 32 L (2 marks); water = 18 L, ratio 16 : 9 (1 mark).

items.stem: In what ratio must pulses costing ₹78 per kg be mixed with pulses costing ₹102 per kg so that the mixture costs ₹81 per kg?
items.markingKey: By alligation, cheaper : dearer = (d − m) : (m − c) = (102 − 81) : (81 − 78) = 21 : 3 = 7 : 1.
